1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   function playBeep(freq, dur) {
7:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
10:     osc.type = 'square';
11:     osc.connect(gain);
12:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     osc.start();
15:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
16:   }
17:   function playSound(type) {
18:     switch(type) {
19:       case 'shoot': playBeep(800, 0.08); break;
20:       case 'explosion': playBeep(200, 0.15); break;
21:       case 'pickup': playBeep(400, 0.12); break;
22:       case 'gameover': playBeep(100, 0.4); break;
23:     }
24:   }
25:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
26:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
27:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
28:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
29:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
30: 
31:   // ----- Game State -----
32:   const ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, w: 40, h: 20, speed: 4, ammo: 10, fuel: 100 };
33:   const bullets = [];
34:   const asteroids = [];
35:   const fuels = [];
36:   let keys = {};
37:   let gameOver = false;
38:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
39:   let lastFuel = 0;
40: 
41:   // ----- Input -----
42:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
43:     keys[e.code] = true;
44:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
45:   });
46:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
47: 
48:   function spawnAsteroid() {
49:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
50:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (W - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 });
51:   }
52: 
53:   function spawnFuel() {
54:     const size = 15;
55:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (W - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: 1 });
56:   }
57: 
58:   // ----- Game Loop -----
59:   function update(dt) {
60:     if (gameOver) return;
61:     // ship movement
62:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
63:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
64:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.y -= ship.speed;
65:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.y += ship.speed;
66:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
67:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y));
68: 
69:     // shooting
70:     if (keys['Space'] && ship.ammo > 0) {
71:       // simple rate limiting: one bullet per 200ms
72:       if (!ship.lastShot || Date.now() - ship.lastShot > 200) {
73:         bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 2, y: ship.y, w: 4, h: 10, speed: 6 });
74:         ship.ammo--;
75:         ship.lastShot = Date.now();
76:         playSound('shoot');
77:       }
78:     }
79: 
80:     // update bullets
81:     bullets.forEach(b => (b.y -= b.speed));
82:     // remove off-screen bullets
83:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (bullets[i].y + bullets[i].h < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
84: 
85:     // spawn asteroids
86:     if (Date.now() - lastAsteroid > 1000) {
87:       spawnAsteroid();
88:       lastAsteroid = Date.now();
89:     }
90:     // spawn fuel pickups
91:     if (Date.now() - lastFuel > 5000) {
92:       spawnFuel();
93:       lastFuel = Date.now();
94:     }
95: 
96:     // update asteroids and check collisions
97:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
98:       const a = asteroids[i];
99:       a.y += a.speed;
100:       // bullet collision
101:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
102:         const b = bullets[j];
103:         if (b.x < a.x + a.w && b.x + b.w > a.x && b.y < a.y + a.h && b.y + b.h > a.y) {
104:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
105:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
106:           playSound('explosion');
107:           break;
108:         }
109:       }
110:       // ship collision
111: if (!gameOver && ship.x < a.x + a.w && ship.x + ship.w > a.x && ship.y < a.y + a.h && ship.y + ship.h > a.y) {
112:           gameOver = true;
113:           playSound('gameover');
114:         }
115:       // remove off-screen
116:       if (a.y > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
117:     }
118: 
119:     // fuel pickups
120:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
121:       const f = fuels[i];
122:       f.y += f.speed;
123: if (ship.x < f.x + f.w && ship.x + ship.w > f.x && ship.y < f.y + f.h && ship.y + ship.h > f.y) {
124:           ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
125:           fuels.splice(i, 1);
126:           playSound('pickup');
127:           continue;
128:         }
129:       if (f.y > H) fuels.splice(i, 1);
130:     }
131: 
132:     // fuel consumption
133:     ship.fuel -= dt * 0.02; // drain over time
134:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
135:   }
136: 
137: // generate simple starfield background
138: const stars = [];
139: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
140:   stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5, twinkle: Math.random() });
141: }
142: 
143: function drawBackground() {
144:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
145:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
146:   stars.forEach(st => {
147:     // simple twinkle effect
148:     const alpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 1000 + st.twinkle * Math.PI * 2);
149:     ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
150:     ctx.beginPath();
151:     ctx.arc(st.x, st.y, st.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:     ctx.fill();
153:   });
154: }
155: 
156: function draw() {
157:     drawBackground();
158:     // ship - triangle
159:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
162:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
163:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
164:     ctx.closePath();
165:     ctx.fill();
166:     // bullets - small circles
167:     bullets.forEach(b => {
168:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
169:       ctx.beginPath();
170:       ctx.arc(b.x + b.w/2, b.y + b.h/2, b.w, 0, Math.PI*2);
171:       ctx.fill();
172:     });
173:     // asteroids - circles with gradient
174:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
175:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/4, a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2);
176:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
177:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
178:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:     });
183:     // fuel pickups - glowing orbs
184:     fuels.forEach(f => {
185:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x + f.w/2, f.y + f.h/2, f.w/4, f.x + f.w/2, f.y + f.h/2, f.w/2);
186:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
187:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
188:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
189:       ctx.beginPath();
190:       ctx.arc(f.x + f.w/2, f.y + f.h/2, f.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
191:       ctx.fill();
192:     });
193:     // UI
194:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
195:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
196:     ctx.fillText(`Ammo: ${ship.ammo}`, 10, 20);
197:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.round(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
198:     if (gameOver) {
199:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
200:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
201:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
202:       ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
203:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
204:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
205:     }
206:   }
207:   }
208: 
209:   let last = performance.now();
210:   function loop() {
211:     const now = performance.now();
212:     const dt = now - last;
213:     last = now;
214:     update(dt);
215:     draw();
216:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
217:     else setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 3000);
218:   }
219:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
220: })();

(End of file - total 220 lines)
</content>
